findings.scope: whole pinned file, static inspection; analyzer not executed
observations: subprocess timeout defaults to 300 seconds; capture_output buffers stdout and stderr with no output byte cap in this wrapper.
Return code is not checked when XML exists; any parseable XML without error nodes yields an empty result, with no validation of results root/version or explicit completeness status.
XML is accepted only when stripped stderr or stdout begins with the XML declaration; progress before the declaration is not extracted despite the comment about interleaved progress.
scan_to_findings drops diagnostics without primary locations and missingIncludeSystem.
Resolved paths outside repo_root are retained as original file paths when relative_to raises ValueError; caller target validation does not validate each emitted diagnostic path.
findings.transfer_to_dedup: Keep scan completion and tool failure distinct from zero matches; bound buffered subprocess output. No implementation copied.

observations: Identity is truncated SHA1 over path, line and normalized title, not file content equality.
Repeated fingerprints in the same record_run increment run_count per finding rather than per run.
Updates replace finding_json but leave severity/category/confidence/title columns unchanged; isolated control confirms stale severity.
Missing/unreadable current source line falls through to still_present; deleted source file confirmed by control.
Default history retention is unbounded; list_all materializes all rows; compare opens a connection per finding.
Embedding singleton is shared across all requested model names; vectorstore cache keyed only by persist directory.

index_documents forwards each call with no stable IDs, source replacement or duplicate check in this wrapper; fake backend confirms repeated additions forwarded. Actual Chroma duplicate semantics not executed.
count and list_sources collapse backend errors to empty values; clear suppresses delete errors and evicts cached object.
delete_by_source returns 1 for successful API invocation without checking deleted chunk count.
Paragraph-aware chunk size is not a hard bound: a single 5000-character paragraph remains one chunk despite max_chars=1000; confirmed.
Directory traversal sorts and materializes all rglob entries before max_files check; count increases only for files producing documents. No overall byte/page/chunk budget.
File symlink resolving outside input directory is loaded; confirmed with temporary fixture. No containment check after load_file resolves target.
UTF-8 decode ignores invalid bytes; markdown headers are regex matched even inside fenced blocks.
PDF construction errors are caught but page iteration/extract_text errors are outside that catch; DOCX paragraphs exclude table content. Parser runtime not executed.
Finding constrains confidence and string lengths but no positive line bounds, line_end ordering, path containment, or evidence requirement for verified=True.
ReviewReport tracks reviewed/skipped files but has no explicit completion flag or structured failures; counters and duration have no nonnegative constraints.
verified field describes self-verification, whereas previously read cppcheck conversion sets it true directly for static findings; semantics differ.

findings.scope: whole-file static inspection; historical hardcoded pricing not checked against live prices

Pricing data is a pinned repository claim, not evidence of current provider pricing; no actual model calls.
load_all_profiles suppresses ImportError and ValueError across each complete module import; unavailable profiles and unrelated module initialization ValueErrors have no diagnostic here.
Registry rejects duplicate names; handles_extension lowercases input but does not add leading dot.
Base profile contains extension/language metadata and tool hooks; actual traversal and budget enforcement are elsewhere.

findings.scope: whole pinned graph; static inspection; no model/tool execution
observations: Budget checked after LLM call and around entire tool batch; all batch calls execute once batch begins, so batch can exceed remaining tool budget. Iteration capped at 30.
If used already meets budget, response tool calls receive no paired ToolMessages before loop exits; reflect uses a separate message list, checkpoint history may retain unmatched calls.
